fusions.name: Harvest Sweep
fusions.desc: A curved sweep of flint that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crescent Cut
fusions.desc: Throws a curved flint blade that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gathered In
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Reaper's Footing
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
